decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have their own product page and fit the firm's core thermoforming materials range for dental labs, so the investment and visible commitment favor keeping them.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a core consumable in the firm's established splint and aligner workflow, has its own page, and carries strong commitment, making a drop unlikely.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned rather than featured, so commitment is lower, but it supports the firm's digital and 3D-print finishing direction and costs little to keep.

Custom hearing protection draws on the firm's custom earmold manufacturing competence and its hearing-care channel, and weak results can still be blamed on temporary pandemic effects, so management would keep it despite dropping the related earmold line.
